method: Independent direct full-rank image affine registration using OpenCV ECC; separate from historical LK observer, not a replacement or score adjustment.
samplePolicy: All43 actual output frame clocks from existing matched controls, no omission of failed/low-support timestamps. Exact actual PTS/control bindings retained.
geometry: Existing source image crop affine OFF-to-ON is expected geometry. Observed affine independently fitted from final decoded OFF/ON image pixels, initialized with that expected transform; no fitted result is ground truth.
ownership: Same field-box and registered Native/decoded primary glyph exclusion; erode by2 output pixels for one 3x3 derivative and bilinear interpolation support. No pyramids or21px LK support are used by this observer.
identifiability: Require full numerical rank6 of affine gradient Jacobian. Textureless/occluded/nonconvergent/unresolved displacement stays UNMEASURED.
acceptance: Existing per-pixel geometric error <= max(0.5px,10% expected displacement) with >=90% agreement. Require resolved median expected displacement>=0.5px and alignment improvement > max(1 luma,3*max(ON_REPEAT noise,original-vs-ON noise)). No artistic score.
layering: Existing opening background return remains CONFOUNDED independent of geometric fit. No whole-interval/camera intent claim from blended layers.
